name: 90813 · Long Beach, CA
findings: ZIP 90813 (Long Beach) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90813 (Long Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90813 (Long Beach) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
